description: What Your day did for the user over the last `days` days (default 7): the briefs it wrote, every note it sent and how ('sent_from_gmail' went out from their Gmail; 'opened_in_gmail' opened a prefilled Gmail window, so the user pressed send there or not), which of those it sent without asking because the user had let that kind of note go unasked, notes that failed, waited too long and were not sent, or are still waiting, and every yes, edit, dismiss and answer the user gave on an item. Call this for 'what did Your day send?', 'did anything go out for me?' and 'what did I approve this week?'. Read-only.

days.description: How many days back to look (default 7, max 31).

name: what_your_day_did
title: What Your day did
